artists.biography: James is a British rock band from Manchester, England. They formed in 1982 and were active throughout the 1980s, but most successful during the 1990s. Their hit singles include "Come Home", "Sit Down", and "She's a Star" as well as their American college radio hit "Laid". Following the departure of lead singer Tim Booth in 2001, the band became inactive but re-formed in January 2007, returning for a new album and international tour. Up to 2010, the band had sold more than 25 million albums worldwide.

Their hit singles include "Come Home", "Sit Down", and "She's a Star" as well as their American college radio hit "Laid". Following the departure of lead singer Tim Booth in 2001, the band became inactive but re-formed in January 2007, returning for a new album and international tour. Up to 2010, the band had sold more than 25 million albums worldwide.

perplexity.description:
Pleased To Meet You is the ninth studio album by British rock band James, originally released on July 2, 2001, through Mercury and Fontana Records. Musically, the album blends alternative rock with elements of pop and electronic textures, showcasing the band's evolving sound in the early 2000s. The production is polished and atmospheric, with layered guitars, melodic hooks, and introspective lyrics, reflecting a more mature and cohesive approach compared to their earlier, more anthemic work.

Within James' discography, Pleased To Meet You stands out as a transitional record, bridging their classic Britpop roots with a more experimental and nuanced style. It followed a period of lineup changes and marked a shift toward a subtler, mood-driven aesthetic. The album received generally positive reviews for its consistency and songcraft, with critics noting its emotional depth and sonic refinement. While it did not achieve the same commercial heights as some of their earlier releases, it is often regarded as one of the band's most artistically unified albums.
